scope: Core Ki Blast Ultimate coverage expansion

records.name: Super Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku and numerous Goku-family/fusion Customize Partners
records.effect: Charges and fires a large, fast-traveling Kamehameha beam; current page confirms multi-hit behavior. Gogeta (SSGSS) has a unique charge input that grants a temporary 23% all-damage boost and slight movement-speed increase; Gohan (DBS Super Hero) has a counter variant.

records.name: Saiyan Spirit
records.character_source: Bardock; Goku (GT) Customize Partner; Saiyan CaCs
records.effect: Pseudo-strike rush into a blue Ki beam; current page reports 10 hits and 30% total damage. The move is restricted to Saiyan CaCs.

records.name: Explosive Assault
records.effect: Fires a barrage of Ki balls for 22 hits and 40% total damage, then leaves the user exhausted for about one second.

records.name: Special Beam Cannon
records.character_source: Piccolo; Gohan (Adult); Gohan (Future); Cell (Perfect); Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) Customize Partners
records.effect: Fires an unblockable long-range beam for 30% damage in one hit; the damage is the same whether it hits during a combo or after a delayed run-in.

notes: All four identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json during the coverage audit. Dedicated Xenoverse 2 pages establish the canonical Ultimate/Ki Blast classification and 300-Ki cost. CaC availability is explicitly supported by the listed training/TP Shop routes or the Saiyan CaC note. 2026-09-25 evidence refresh: current pages confirm the listed mechanics; no unsupported drop probabilities, Ultimate Finish conditions, shop-price semantics, or version history were inferred.
